item.title: Call for Proposals: Biochar for Smallholder Soil Health in India
item.description: Deadline: 30-Nov-2026 Donor Name: Example Climate Foundation. The Foundation
item.content:encoded: Deadline: 30-Nov-2026 Donor Name: Example Climate Foundation. The Foundation invites Indian NGOs and civil society organisations to submit proposals for village-scale biochar production that improves soil health and sequesters carbon. Grants of up to USD 150,000 for two years. Eligibility: registered non-profit organisations in India with FCRA registration.
